description: ADCOS Identity object: an asymmetric-key-backed identity independent of access technology (spec/architecture.md §6.2, LOCK-005). Credential material is represented only as opaque references and is never serialized as ordinary topology/resource data (LOCK-023). Key lifecycle, rotation, revocation, and algorithm agility are owned by WORK-004 and are deliberately not modeled here.

credential_references.description: Opaque references to node/operator/user credential material held outside ordinary topology data. Never contains secret material itself.

node_id.description: Stable NodeID derived from a public-key identity or a registered equivalent; survives changes of access technology.

title: ADCOS Identity
